description: Submit an enterprise IP whitelist request to raise the daily unpaid compilation quota from the default 3 jobs/24h up to 25–100 jobs/day for a shared corporate NAT or CI/CD runner IP. Call this tool when calligraphy_compile_board returns IPRateLimitExceededError (HTTP 429) for a legitimate engineering team. Requires customer_email, organization_name, and reason, plus optional requested_daily_limit (integer) and client_ip. Returns JSON with request_id, status ('PENDING_CHAIRMAN_OR_SUPPORT_APPROVAL'), ip_address, and requested_daily_limit.

client_ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to whitelist (in remote HTTP mode, automatically resolved from the caller's connection IP). Example: '198.51.100.77'.

customer_email.description: Corporate work email address of the engineering lead requesting the quota increase. Example: 'lead@apexrobotics.io'.

organization_name.description: Legal organization or hardware team name operating behind the shared IP. Example: 'Apex Robotics Inc.'.

reason.description: Brief engineering justification for the higher daily compilation limit (e.g., team size or CI/CD regression pipeline). Example: '8 PCB engineers sharing office NAT'.

requested_daily_limit.description: Requested maximum daily compilations per 24-hour window (integer between 10 and 100). Default: 25.

name: calligraphy_request_ip_whitelist
title: Request Enterprise IP Whitelist Quota
